title: Solid Core vs. Foam Core PVC in DWV Systems
description: Selecting the correct PVC pipe material is critical for structural performance and code compliance in drainage, waste, and vent (DWV) systems. Solid Core PVC features a uniform, high-density plastic composition throughout its wall thickness, offering high impact resistance and crush strength. Foam Core PVC features a cellular plastic core sandwiched between solid outer layers, making it lighter and easier to handle for non-pressure gravity drainage. While both are widely used in residential DWV applications, solid core is often preferred for underground burial or areas exposed to potential impact. Always verify code approval before installation.
